# Findings: traffic/限流 detection & product fields

## How traffic is detected today

Traffic is **DOM-based**, not from `pageQuery` limit fields.

| Signal | How | Key functions |
|--------|-----|---------------|
| **商品流量待关注** | Quick-filter chip count + row badge | `readChipCount`, `scanProducts` → `watch` |
| **商品流量近期有下降** | Per-row red badge (current page only) | `countDeclineBadges`, `scanProducts` → `decline` |
| **Only on-sale** | Row text 在售 / 已下架… | `detectSaleStatus` → `onlyOnSale` (plugin v15) |

**Paths**
- `E:\project\temu\temu-plugin\content.js` — `scanProducts`, `readTraffic`, `scanWatchList`
- `E:\project\temu\temu-plugin\background.js` — `_diffAndAlert`, `pickFreshItems` (6h cooldown by `productId`)

`pageQuery` has `flowLimitStatus` / `flowLimit` / `flowLimitStyle` but they are **unused** and were **null** in the capture sample. Live traffic alerts do not use them.

```text
productId   ← SPU ID:(\d+)
skc         ← SKC ID:(\d+)
name        ← Chinese title in info td
watch       ← bool (商品流量待关注)
decline     ← bool (商品流量近期有下降)
```
